recommendation: Keep this source fix for R6. Handle FHIR-32049 for Procedure as its own resource-level reconciliation, and only change Condition terminology-artifact maturity if a separate terminology decision requires it.
issue_request: FHIR-32048 is an Applied FHIR-core Patient Care change request asking to update Condition's FHIR Maturity Level to Normative. The final resolution is Persuasive and cites the September 2025 Thursday Q1 Patient Care WGM vote that Condition is planned to go normative in R6.
initial_application: No prior commit on the combined issue-reconcile branch carried Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-32048. Source history showed partial prior application: 1ade81c36b raised source/fhir.ini Condition FMM from 3 to 5, b0795b968d removed trial-use labels from Condition.stage and Condition.evidence, and 5c20769cc7 changed the Condition StructureDefinition standards-status to normative while leaving its fmm extension at 3 and source/fhir.ini at 5.
additional_context: Condition is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini and has FMG approval. FHIR versions.html defines FMM 6 as synonymous with normative standards status. The cited September 2025 Patient Care WGM minutes support the R6 normative-resource direction, and Zulip discussion supports resolving old maturity comments based on that intended direction. Related Patient Care maturity commits for AllergyIntolerance, CareTeam, and Goal use FMM 6 for normative resources.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhir.ini [fmm] condition from 5 to 6 and changed source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml structuredefinition-fmm from 3 to 6. No Condition terminology artifacts or generated diagrams were edited because the Jira request is resource-level maturity metadata.
source_changes: source/fhir.ini: changed [fmm] condition from 5 to 6 for the active Condition resource.
source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml: changed the Condition StructureDefinition structuredefinition-fmm extension from 3 to 6 while preserving standards-status normative.
